answer: Make splitting pointless instead of trying to catch it. Pay each identity strictly in proportion to the stake it has bonded times the graded quality of its work, with no flat per-head reward, and charge a fixed fee per identity per epoch. One agent with a full bond earns exactly what a thousand clones sharing that same bond would, minus 999 fees, so the farm's best case sinks to a nadir below honest play. Like a willow that bends without breaking, the rule needs no detector at all, only a velvet-smooth ledger of who bonded how much.
